descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a motivated and experienced Full Stack Developer who enjoys building reliable, scalable software and working with modern technologies. You should be comfortable working in a distributed engineering environment and collaborating with colleagues across multiple technical disciplines and countries.
 What you will do: 
Actively participate in creating the architecture, design and the implementation of new features;
Continuously add improvements to the existing codebase;
Write maintainable and well-tested code, including integration and unit tests;
Participate in writing software documentation;
Act as a mentor for less-experienced colleagues.
 What you need to have: 
Experience with Agile methodologies, such as Scrum and/or Kanban.
Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) principles and tools.
Experience designing and developing reusable, maintainable software components.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
Substantial professional experience with Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.
Substantial experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web components.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with message brokers, such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
Good understanding of distributed systems, including the ability to explain concepts such as the CAP theorem, consistency, availability, and partition tolerance.
Experience with at least one cloud platform, preferably AWS.
Experience using AI-assisted software engineering tools in day-to-day development.
Familiarity with deploying and operating AI/LLM workloads.
Strong experience with Git-based development workflows.
Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or equivalent automation platforms.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines.
A strong focus on software quality, maintainability, testing, reliability, and security.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
 #LI-AT2
